changes: Volumetric clouds take real cloud shapes: flat bases, billowing rounded tops, wispy undersides, leaning in the wind.
Cloud types by weather: thin stratus sheets, stratocumulus, cumulus and the odd towering cumulonimbus with an anvil.
Clouds no longer look dithered or pixelated when you fly up to them: smoother sampling, steadier frames and more detail near the cloud layer.
